messages:
elaine: Heads-up — FinBank kickoff today. They signed for Dedicated + BYOK pilot but pushed for two non-negotiables: (1) per-tenant evidence delivery (searchable exports) with a 5s SLA for indexed queries, and (2) per-route retention overrides (legal-hold-friendly). Need scoping + owners.

sam: Can we confirm whether the 5s target is for cold archive queries or for live indexed data? big diff in infra. :thinking_face:

elaine: Good q. FinBank specifically said 'operational search on evidence index' — so assume hot/indexed. They expect ~10k queries/day peak for a single tenant.

ryan: For hot index we can hit 5s if we provision dedicated query shards + async ingestion. Cost will jump. Estimate: +2x Ops cost per tenant.

priya: From security: BYOK handshake + evidence export integrity checks must be part of MVP. We need HMAC-signed export bundles and verifiable chain-of-custody metadata. Also legal wants retention flags tied to tenant-level policy.

miguel: Quick implementation sketch for retention overrides: store per-tenant "retention_policy_id" on metadata, have a lookup during ingest/search. Pseudocode:```sql
UPDATE evidence SET retention_id = :id WHERE tenant = :t;
```This works but search index must be tag-aware.

laura: Ops note: adding per-tenant shards means we need autoscaling rules and a circuit-breaker for noisy tenants. Suggest a soft-limit + alerting model first.

elaine: MVP launch criteria proposal (short):
- BYOK handshake documented + test vector with FinBank
- Evidence export format v1 (ndjson) + HMAC signature
- Search SLA: 95th percentile <= 5s for indexed queries under outlined QPS
- Per-tenant retention override implemented and UI toggle in Console (opt-in)
- Rollout plan: pilot with 1 customer, canary on dedicated pool, rollback path to shared index

sam: Need acceptance tests. I'll own a small test matrix:
- ingest 100k events, run 10k queries, measure p95 
- export bundle validation (signature + manifest)
- retention toggles respected on search + export
I'll post test script in repo.

priya: Legal ask: include "data subject request" path in export (anonymization flag) — FinBank said possible regulators will request redacted exports. We should include a field in manifest: `redaction_applied: true|false`.

ryan: Engineering tradeoffs: if we include redaction at export time, that's expensive. Option B: mark sensitive spans and provide an API that returns pre-redacted views (slower). Need to align on which FinBank expects.

elaine: Action items agreed: 
- sam -> test matrix + perf harness (due EOD Tue)
- ryan -> infra sizing draft + cost delta (due Wed)
- priya -> legal manifest template + redaction options (due Wed)
- miguel -> retention lookup + index tagging prototype (PR by Fri)
- laura -> canary+alert runbook (draft Thurs)

sam: I'll add an automated scenario that simulates tenant spike + noisy-query throttling.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: infra/prototype -> staging at 2024-06-12T18:30Z (sha: a1b2c3). :rocket:

elaine: Let's sync tomorrow 10am PT for sign-off on the manifest and test results. If we clear, we tell FinBank we can start pilot week of Jun 24.

ryan: One more thought — telemetry: add per-tenant token-level latency metrics so FinBank can audit SLA compliance. Who owns metrics schema?

miguel: I'll propose a minimal schema: `tenant_id`, `route`, `latency_ms`, `p95_window`. Keep it lightweight.

priya: +1. Also ensure logs contain key rotation events for BYOK (timestamp, requester, key_fingerprint).

elaine: Great. I'll consolidate this thread into a concise spec doc after the Wed updates and tag legal/ops. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
